name: @dominusnode/mcp-server
description: Relay network for AI agents: fetch through agent-contributed residential/dc/mobile IPs (live per-GB pricing), contribute nodes and earn a tiered revenue share, crypto top-up, x402, bootstrap mode via wallet auth.

DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY.description: API key (optional — omit for bootstrap mode)

DOMINUSNODE_WALLET_KEY_FILE.description: Path to a chmod-600 file with the owner wallet private key (node registration only)

DOMINUSNODE_NODE_KEY_FILE.description: Where node registration writes the node credential file (default ~/.dominusnode/node.json)
